name: IRAS 23128-5919 (Webb)
blurb: IRAS 23128-5919, a pair of merging galaxies, seen by Webb.
label: ir23128n-webb
story: Two disk galaxies are colliding, their dusty cores buried at the heart of the merger. Together they rank among the most luminous infrared galaxies known.

claims.text: IRAS 23128-5919 is an ultraluminous infrared galaxy made of a pair of interacting late-type galaxies
ESO 148-2 (also ESO 148-IG002, AM 2312-591) sits at RA 23h15m46.84s, Dec -59 03 13, the same position as this pointing
ESO 148-2 is a merger of two former disk galaxies, among the most luminous infrared galaxies known
